title: How to avoid lifting plateaus
summary: Video on avoiding plateaus in lifting; the auto-captions are garbled (misdetected language) and unusable, so only the title and a joking description survive. claims: Joking 'easy' answer to plateaus: stop working in the service industry, a bilingual pun on plateau as a serving tray
